verdict.rationale: Bruno's docs homepage has one line saying it can serve realistic mock responses while you build, which points to a first-party mocking capability for consumers before the API exists. Nothing in the pack explains how a mock server is started, what it is generated from, or how far it goes. Missing for 10: documentation of spinning up a mock server, generation from saved examples, generation from an OpenAPI/spec, how consumers reach the mock endpoint, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up a mock server from saved examples or a spec so consumers can build before the API exists

citations.quote: Serve realistic mock responses while you build.
